screens.title: Your job
screens.body: You're the compliance officer at a data center. Each lab may use {flop_limit} training FLOPs and {energy_limit} kJ per period, and some will cheat. Every chip seals a report of each job. Stamp each report Allow or Block.

screens.title: Anatomy of a record

zones.label: The seal
zones.note: Made by a key that never leaves the chip.

zones.label: Sticky notes from the lab (not sealed)

screens.closing: Sticky notes can be swapped freely. Change anything sealed and the seal breaks.

check.prompt: Sealed or not? Tap each field.

screens.title: Three checks before you trust a report

items.question: Is the chip in the registry?
items.why: If not, no one vouches for it.

items.question: Does the seal match its registered key?
Is the counter higher than last time?
items.why: If not, it's an old report.

screens.closing: Pass all three, then charge the owner and check the limits.

screens.title: Your shift
screens.body: Each level is a timed shift. When time runs out, waiting reports pass unchecked. Keep two counters low: Slipped (violations allowed) and Complaints (honest labs blocked).

practice.note: The guided first record of Level 1 is the practice record: untimed, ungraded, and replayable from the Rulebook.
